related_gaps.rationale: This changes help text, argument errors and one docs sentence; the page gate's checks are untouched.
Nothing here changes what is protected or what hosting must enforce.

gap_review: Read the four open gaps. artifact-gate-holes and hosting-enforcement are near this work and unaffected; product-acceptance and platform-qualification are unrelated.

discoveries.summary: check, workflow and release bind any word, so they took --help as their value (unknown profile, unknown workflow id, unknown release scope); a help scan had to run before the match, which now stops at -- so run's arguments stay the application's.

The verdict catch-all's wording was pinned by verdict_records_findings_and_model, a completion test, so removing the catch-all meant changing that assertion to look for the usage; the interview page had assumed no test checked it, and the reference page corrected it.
Out of scope: a wrong --task id answers 'No such file or directory (os error 2)' without naming the task (task_record.rs reads the record file directly).

discovery_review: Three discoveries, each recorded where its next reader looks: the --help capture in the main.rs comment above the scan, the pinned verdict wording in the router test it changed, and the unnamed missing task in the reference page. Calls the implementation left to the reader (flags still in fixed order; verdict notes of exactly -h now ask for help) are in the implementation notes.
